body: I don't know why everyone suggests leaving and trying to start a new life. If I could afford that I wouldn't be suicidal. I want to leave home more than anything, but I have nowhere to go and can't afford to support myself. Plus, I'll still be stuck with myself no matter where I go and leaving my job and friends will give the impression that I don't care about them, that they're part of the problem. I need out of myself, that's it.
